title: Jati hai teri bahen alweda shahe zaman
body:
JATI HAI TERI BAHEN ALVIDA SHAH-E-ZAMAN
LO SALAM-E-AAKHRI ZEHRA KI JAA’N TASHNA DAHAN
Leke jati hoon nigahon mein mai manzar karb ke
Dasht mein jalti zamee’n par bekafan laashe pade
<<DIVIDER>>
Aik rassi mein bandhe barah aseero ke gale
Chhodkar tanha tujhe jati hai Zainab pur-mehan
Yaad tadpayegi sabki lamha lamha umr bhar
Chhodkar jati hai maaye’n apne sab noor-e-nazar
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaun de unko dilasa bibiyaa hai nohagar
Hoon main sharminda tujhee de nahi payi kafan
Kaise nana ko sunaungi bhala ye daastaa’n
Lut gaya karbobala ke dasht mein sab kaarwaa’n
<<DIVIDER>>
Thaa mehaar oonton ki thaame aage aage naatawaa’n
Kya kahun tera huwa paamaal ghodo se badan
Jaaungi maajaye jis dum main watan ko lautkar
Khulke amma se sunaaungi mai roodad-e-safar
<<DIVIDER>>
The tamashayi sabhi saidaniya thi nange sar
Bekajawa oont the aur baazuwon mein thi rasaan
Yaad aati hai to jalta hai kaleja baar baar
Sar jhukaye ro rahi hai Umm-e-Farwa sogwaar
<<DIVIDER>>
Chain ab aata nahi sab bibiyaa’n hain beqarar
Saath lekar jaa rahi hai chand lamhon ki dulhan
